edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender directly to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender] as spender allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
transferOwnership stores the caller-chosen newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and resets it to address(0).
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner role.
approveAndCall performs an external call into an attacker-controlled spender contract.
The callee can re-enter approveAndCall before the outer call returns.
The callee can re-enter transferFrom using the freshly granted allowance.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to a caller-supplied token contract.
A malicious tokenAddress can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token during the external transfer.
transfer debits the sender using safeSub.
transfer credits the recipient using safeAdd.
transferFrom uses safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
safeAdd result is written into the balances mapping.
safeSub result is written into the balances mapping.
transfer updates both sender and recipient entries of balances.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decreases allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before the external call.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
Constructor sets the fixed total supply.
Constructor mints the whole supply into balances of a fixed address.
Constructor sets the token symbol.
Constructor sets the token name.
Constructor sets the token decimals.
Parameter a is the first operand of the checked addition.
Parameter b is the second operand of the checked addition.
Local c captures the arithmetic result returned by safeAdd.
_newOwner is stored as the pending owner.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
tokenOwner is the outer key of the allowance lookup.
spender is the key written in approve.
spender becomes the target contract of the external receiveApproval call.
The spender argument determines which untrusted contract is invoked.
to is the credited account in transfer.
to is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens is the amount subtracted and added in transfer.
tokens bounds the balance and allowance debits in transferFrom.
tokens is the allowance value set in approve.
tokens is both the allowance and the amount forwarded to the callee.
from is the debited account and allowance key in transferFrom.
data is forwarded unchanged into the external call.
Attacker-controlled data is passed to the untrusted receiveApproval callee.
tokenAddress selects the untrusted contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token.
